rule: Background 1 with scattered 8 noise hides several same-size k x k boxes, each with a solid 8 border and a 2/8 interior containing a 2. All boxes share one interior pattern except one, and orientation matters. The output is the box whose interior is unique, cropped with its border.
scope: Construct repeated framed patterns with exactly one odd pattern, amidst noise and invalid-frame decoys. Output is the latent odd box. Random scenes exclude competing unique windows, including nested or oversized candidates.
constraints: All four canonical pairs reconstruct exactly and 1,000 distinct independent archived-solver seeds pass.

Independent exhaustive row-bitset window oracle passes 1,362 distinct scenes. It checks all window sizes up to the grid side, rather than only the planted size. Canonical fixtures retain their original first-unique-window interpretation.
Dense controls previously failing now pass: size 5 with 16 boxes; 16 size-4 boxes in 19x19; nine size-8 boxes in 30x30. Ninety such cases pass, plus every feasible size/count combination at 30x30.

Audit includes 755 same-cell-count odd patterns, 384 rotated/reflected odd patterns and 366 nested-window scenes. Lattice fallback occurs in 167 scenes, including 56/1000 defaults; measured rather than assumed rare.

Thirteen malformed or infeasible controls reject promptly. Critic 24 valid and eight rejection cases pass. Its old size-8/odd-index-5 rejection is superseded by explicitly documented support for six sampled boxes.

authored_scope: Supported: box side 4..8 (6..8 synthetic); sampled box counts 3..8 for k<=5 and 3..6 for k>=6, biased to 3..5; explicit num_boxes 3..16 honoured whenever the exact lattice capacity floor((W+1)/(k+1))*floor((H+1)/(k+1)) allows it, via greedy placement with a randomized lattice fallback (random slack offsets, random slot subset, +/-2 jitter). Infeasible geometry (e.g. 3 gapped 4x4 boxes in 8x8, size 8 with 16 boxes) is rejected up front with ValueError using the same capacity formula that drives dimension choice. Odd patterns come from swap, reflection/rotation, toggle or random variants. Common patterns may have nested ringed-2 windows, as in the canonical test, and the odd pattern may never add a nested window. Optional solid, ring and near-miss decoys. Sampled grids are 10..30 per side and can be non-square. Noise density is 0.08..0.2 by default and up to 0.5 when explicit. Explicit odd_index raises the sampled count to odd_index+1 when feasible, so size=8 with odd_index=5 now succeeds. Fixture replay uses an explicit noise layer plus boxes and patterns. Deliberately not supported: mixed box sizes within one scene, palettes other than 1/8/2, boxes larger than 8 (the reference scans sides 3..8 only), and decoys combined with an explicit noise layer.
authored_constraints: Exactly one planted box carries the odd pattern; there are at least 2 common boxes, so every common or nested interior occurs at least twice.
Strict acceptance applies to every non-fixture scene: every detectable window of side 3..30 is planted or nested in a planted box, and the set of unique-interior windows is exactly [odd box].
The odd pattern differs from the common pattern and adds no nested detectable window that the common pattern lacks.
Sampled boxes and decoys keep a one-cell gap. Explicit boxes must not overlap and must lie inside the grid.
Near-miss decoys copy the common interior and are used only when the common pattern has no nested windows.
Geometry prechecks use the exact gapped-square lattice capacity, counting explicit decoys as slots. Dimension sampling draws only pairs that meet that capacity.
Argument types (ints that are not bools, lists/tuples of strings, integer pairs) are validated before any conversion. A str is rejected for noise, patterns and boxes.
Output is built from the latent odd pattern (_box(k, odd)), never by running a solver.
Explicit fixture scenes are checked with the reference's order-sensitive selection and raise ValueError on mismatch.
